coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output identifies all three prompting methods (Expert, PAL, and BoT) and all three tasks (Game of 24, MGSM, and Checkmate-in-One), matching 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%).
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output does not specify the NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB GPU, 10 repeated runs per task, fixed random seeds, or the same framework installations and BoT repository configuration. It discusses latency but does not identify the required dependent measure as base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance in seconds. Generic replication and reproducibility provisions do not establish the missing controls.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion or numerical results are provided. The output omits the expected increased inference time for BoT relative to single-query methods and the task-specific values, including the exception that BoT is faster than PAL on Game of 24.
